description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It creates a React root on a DOM element with id 'root' and renders the App component inside React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the created root.
